scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m shipsense_api.export_openapi && npm run generate --workspace packages/contracts
scripts.test:foundation: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m unittest discover -s services/api/tests -v
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check services scripts
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --frozen ruff format services scripts
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && uv run --frozen ruff check services scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/contracts && uv run --frozen mypy
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run secrets:check && npm run contracts:check
